verdict.rationale: LM Studio exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API and a CLI (lms) that cover model download, load, chat, and server start/stop, and there's a headless 'llmster' daemon mode for scripting (lm-studio-docs-9,10,11,12,29,31). However, several UI-specific capabilities highlighted in docs—MCP server connection/management, RAG document attachment, chat folders/organization, themes—have no documented API/CLI equivalent, and community feedback notes friction even with headless/API workflows (lm-studio-comm-13,16). Missing for 10: documented API/CLI parity for MCP server setup, RAG document workflows, and chat organization features that exist only in the GUI.
